symbols.name: llMessageLinked
symbols.signature: llMessageLinked(integer link, integer num, string str, key id)
symbols.summary: Deliver a link_message event to scripts in the selected prims.
caveats: A selected script can receive its own message; avoid forwarding loops.
Wide targeting multiplies event delivery.

symbols.name: llSetTimerEvent
symbols.summary: Set this script's timer interval; zero disables it.
caveats: Timer delivery can be late; count elapsed time rather than assuming exact ticks.

symbols.name: llGetNotecardLineSync
symbols.summary: Read a zero-based line from a notecard already present in the simulator cache.
caveats: NAK can mean an unavailable cache entry; retain an asynchronous fallback.
EOF marks a line beyond the card's end.

symbols.name: llHTTPRequest
symbols.signature: key llHTTPRequest(string url, list parameters, string body)
symbols.summary: Start an outgoing HTTP request and return its request handle.
caveats: Handle NULL_KEY when a request cannot be started.
Match the response handle before consuming the body.

symbols.name: llRequestPermissions
symbols.summary: Request avatar permissions as a combined bitmask.
caveats: Execution continues before the permission response.
Request all permissions the script needs together; omitted permissions can be revoked.

symbols.name: llGetUsedMemory
symbols.summary: Report script memory usage in bytes.
caveats: Profile representative peak workloads; an idle reading is not a peak guarantee.

symbols.name: llGetMemoryLimit
symbols.summary: Read the script's current memory limit in bytes.
caveats: A memory limit is a cap, not a statement of remaining headroom.

symbols.name: llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast
symbols.summary: Apply parameter rules to selected linked prims without the ordinary setter's forced sleep.
caveats: Each PRIM rule has its own argument layout and constraints.

symbols.name: llGetTime
symbols.summary: Read elapsed seconds on the script's resettable clock.
caveats: Resetting this clock affects deadlines expressed in its time domain.

symbols.name: llGetAndResetTime
symbols.summary: Read the current script clock and reset it in one call.
caveats: Rebase outstanding deadlines when resetting a clock shared by concurrent activities.

symbols.name: llLinksetDataReadProtected
symbols.summary: Read a protected linkset datastore value using its password.
caveats: An absent name or incorrect password yields an empty string.

symbols.name: llOwnerSay
symbols.summary: Send chat visible to the object's owner.
caveats: Do not put credentials or private request bodies into debugging chat.

symbols.name: llReplaceSubString
symbols.signature: string llReplaceSubString(string src, string pattern, string replacement_pattern, integer count)
symbols.summary: Replace matching substrings in a string.
caveats: Zero count replaces every match; positive and negative counts choose opposite traversal directions.

symbols.name: state_entry
symbols.summary: Run when the script enters a state.

symbols.name: timer
symbols.summary: Handle delivery from the timer configured by llSetTimerEvent.
caveats: The configured interval does not guarantee exact event arrival times.

symbols.name: control
symbols.signature: control(key id, integer level, integer edge)
symbols.summary: Receive captured control levels and changes for an avatar.
caveats: Taking controls requires the appropriate permission.

symbols.name: link_message
symbols.signature: link_message(integer sender_num, integer num, string str, key id)
symbols.summary: Receive a message sent by another or the same linked script.
caveats: Validate the sender and application session before acting.

symbols.name: http_response
symbols.signature: http_response(key request_id, integer status, list metadata, string body)
symbols.summary: Receive an outgoing HTTP request's response.
caveats: A late response can belong to an obsolete request.

symbols.name: dataserver
symbols.summary: Receive the result of an asynchronous data request.
caveats: Correlate queryid with the request you are awaiting.

symbols.name: run_time_permissions
symbols.summary: Receive a permission response bitmask.
caveats: Check granted bits before using permission-dependent functions.

symbols.name: LINK_SET
symbols.summary: Select every prim in the linkset.
caveats: For linked messages this delivers to every script in selected prims.

symbols.name: LINK_ROOT
symbols.summary: Select the root prim in a multi-prim linkset.

symbols.name: LINK_THIS
symbols.summary: Select the prim containing the executing script.

symbols.name: NULL_KEY
symbols.summary: The all-zero UUID string used as a null key value.
caveats: The constant's declared type is string; LSL can cast it to key.

symbols.name: PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS
symbols.summary: Permission bit for capturing an avatar's controls.
